Bland….
Jul 2026 • Family
We ordered lamb chops, pani puri, paneer roles, pork belly and chicken curry.
Portions were and enough for one,
Good - not worthy of a Michelin award.
Pani puri were ok Mango water nice twist but didn’t work as it was more of a puree and over powered the delicate flavours of the crab.
Paneer spring rolls were probably better than expected they had some taste and were cooked well as paneer is not the easiest to cook.
Pork chop - they were terrible. We asked for medium hot and they were bland. Supposedly lamb but they were tough like mutton and when you bit into them they had a very watery taste almost as if they were frozen and the centre had thawed and not been marinated and instead dipped into a paste then cooked. The accompanying salad and dips were ok but nothing to write home about.
The pork belly again very disappointing, pork cooked separate to main sauce not marinated hence it was just pork belly on a curry sauce. The trick is to be able to marinate the pork so it can absorb the spice flavours then cook it.
The chicken curry bland, a simple base with chicken thrown in not marinated at all.
Drinks were ok some of the speciality drinks were nice.
Not deserving of a Michelin award and if it was it’s certainly hasn’t maintained the standard, food quality or expectations of a Michelin restaurant.
Not even worth a try.

Good Food
Dec 2025 • Family
Visited Rang on the 22 Dec after seeing the reviews on social media , it was the supposed to be the high light of my trip to Da Nang as the reviews were overwhelming , we could only book a month in advance so did so in November .
I was totally disappointed with my experience , not with the food but the service , the food was exceptional ( Michelin standards ) the service was below par , I think google reviews are sometimes false or misleading . To be honest and fair the restuarant was busy and the staff were pushed to their limits , running up & down the stairs and couldn’t give the service that is consistent with a Michelin star restuarant , I am not going to complain about the staff as I believe its the owners responsibility to adequately train your staff and have ample staff to service your customers , it was sad to see your staff that night running off their feet .
Would I visit again , no !!!!
Please note the food was exceptional , but maybe it was a bad night or whatever , but Rang I had high expectations and you let me and my wife down .

Little bit of India in the heart of Da Nang.
Dec 2025 • Couples
What a great restaurant in the heart of Da Nang. You walk in off the bustling main street of Da Nang to this Indian colonial style restaurant. It immediately took me back to India. Could easily have been a restaurant in Bangalore. Had the same feel. The staff were great, bit of fun and very attentive. The food was fantastic, very authentic. The servings were extremely generous. I thought the price was very reasonable for what we had. Only here in Da Nang for a week, but planning on a return.
